sourceLineage.origin: STMicroelectronics investor relations — Q2 2026 financial results
Reuters — STMicro Q2 profit miss and outlook

observations: ST reported Q2 2026 revenue of $3.49B, up 26% Y/Y, with 34.8% gross margin.

Reuters reported Q2 EBITDA of $679M versus $797.7M expected and Q3 revenue guidance of $3.70B versus $3.72B consensus, while management raised AI-datacenter ambitions above $1B for 2026 and above $2B for 2027.
On September 9 the CFO said about 80% of the >$2B 2027 AI-datacenter target is expected from fibre-optic data-link chips; server-power revenue is not expected to become meaningful before 2028.
factors: AI-datacenter connectivity revenue is becoming a quantified structural growth vector
broad booking improvement and inventory normalization support recovery
LEO satellite communications provides an additional growth vector
risks: Q2 core profit materially missed market expectations despite the revenue rebound
near-term AI exposure is concentrated in optical connectivity rather than diversified server-power content
2027 targets depend on engaged programs converting as expected
contradictions: Strong revenue recovery and raised AI ambitions coexist with a material Q2 EBITDA expectations miss and still-modest profitability.
unknowns: customer concentration inside optical-connectivity AI revenue
margin profile of the AI connectivity mix versus legacy products

recommendation.reason: Independent expectations evidence now distinguishes strong structural AI demand from the near-term profit miss and concentration risk, giving Alpha reusable source-addressed inputs.
